name: @rask/flow
//: The estate's Svelte Flow layer — the @rask/dockview of @xyflow/svelte, and the same shape: this package is the BINDING (viewer shell, SSR renderer, auto-fit, the layered placer, the --xy-* theme), and the domain graphs stay with their domains: the FGA access graphs are the console's access logic (console/src/lib/access). Folding one in here would make 'the flow package' secretly be a domain package with a generic name. JIT like @rask/api: raw TS/Svelte, no build step. Nothing here may import `#lib/*` or `$app/*`, an API client, or any domain type: if a value is page- or domain-shaped it arrives as a prop.
